tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Warm, not grey: the white of the city colours.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (event, organizer, stats, promo), the tab bar, sheets and the header.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and the search field, chips at rest, logo tiles, the upload area, the secondary button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card borders, the tab bar top edge, dividers, input borders at rest. Decorative — never the only thing that carries meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the three soft tints (16.9:1 light, 16.4:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: location and organizer lines, dates, placeholders, tab labels at rest. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the soft tints (≥5.1:1 light, ≥5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one bold colour: Maastricht red. Primary button fill, the + tab, selected chips, the active tab, saved bookmark, the focus ring. As text on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft (≥4.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills (darker in light, lighter in dark). Never as text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent text: the promo card, association logo tiles, the 'saved' toast. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label, the + glyph, selected chip label). White in light, ink in dark — never literal white in both.

tokens.name: maas
tokens.usage: The river: the quiet second hue. Success, 'Free', the suggestion panel, the 'Translated from Dutch' note, links and Instagram handles. As text on surface, surface-raised and maas-soft (≥5.3:1 light, ≥7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: maas-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for maas text: the Free tag, the suggestion panel, the translation note, the 'Published' confirmation.

tokens.name: on-maas
tokens.usage: Text on a solid maas fill (rare: the 'Newcomers welcome' badge on an image).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber for 'check this': the conflict and duplicate panels, the missing-field hint. As text on warn-soft and surface-raised (≥5.7:1 light, ≥9:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the conflict and duplicate panels and for a missing field on the review form.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: 1.5px border of a missing field and of the warn panels (3.4:1 light, 5.3:1 dark on surface-raised, so the border alone reads).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: 70% overlay behind the promo QR sheet and any bottom sheet.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and Instagram handles: an alias of maas, so links never compete with the accent button.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque (Google Fonts, opsz 12–96, wght 500–800). Loud, slightly odd letterforms — the playful half. Titles, day headers, times and big numbers only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles: This week, Organizers, New event, My WatNu.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Event detail title, organizer profile name, sheet titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Day headers and section headers (Upcoming, Before you publish).

styles.name: time
styles.usage: The start time on event cards and the date line on the detail screen. 24-hour, always.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one number on the organizer stats card and the promo code under the QR.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: DM Sans (Google Fonts, wght 400–700). The clean half: everything that is read rather than glanced at.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Weekly salsa and bachata, all levels, English spoken.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Event titles on cards, organizer names in lists, button labels, field values.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Location and organizer lines, dates under headers, hints, the Instagram handle.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, field labels, small buttons, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags on cards (category, Free, Newcomers welcome), the step counter, the status bar.

spacing.note: 4px base. Tailwind's default scale already has every step (1 = 4px … 10 = 40px); no config needed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and tags; between stacked tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row; between the title and its meta line inside a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; inner padding of a compact event card; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The screen gutter (left and right of every screen); card and panel padding; gap between a day header and its first card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large panels (upload area, QR sheet).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections: day groups on Home, blocks on the detail screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding under the status bar before a screen title; space above the Publish button.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; the bottom inset above the tab bar for the last card.

radius.note: Rounded, never round — except chips, the + button and avatars, which are pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags on cards, the translation note, the step indicator segments. Tailwind rounded-lg.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, logo tiles, the search field. Tailwind rounded-xl.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Event, organizer, stats and promo cards; warning panels. Tailwind rounded-2xl.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Event images, the upload area, bottom sheets (top corners), the phone frame. Tailwind rounded-3xl.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the + tab button, the follow avatars. Tailwind rounded-full.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable thing: buttons (md), rows, tab items.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Full-width primary actions: Publish, Follow, Save.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height.

tokens.name: size-logo
tokens.usage: Organizer logo tile in lists and on the detail screen; 72px on the profile header.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height, plus the device's bottom safe area below it.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: The + create button in the tab bar; it rises 12px above the bar.

tokens.name: size-screen
tokens.usage: Design width. Layouts are fluid from 360 to 430; above 480 the app is centred at 430.

shadow.note: Cards sit on a hairline, not a shadow. Only two things float: the + button and sheets. The dark theme drops shadows (borders do the work).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Event and organizer cards at rest, barely there; none in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (the QR sheet), the tab bar over content.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The + create button only: an accent-coloured glow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px of solid accent (≥4.5:1 on every surface). Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.
